name: Reda Dahmani
title: Full-stack developper, Software developper
bio: I build and scale web application from concept to completion.
aboutme: Hi! I’m Reda, a passionate junior web developer currently training to become a full-stack developer. I enjoy building clean, responsive, and user-friendly websites that bring ideas to life. I also have a strong interest in design and am proficient in using Figma to create intuitive and visually appealing user interfaces. I’m constantly learning new technologies like React, Node.js, and Next.js to improve my skills and create better experiences. I love solving problems and turning challenges into creative solutions. Outside of coding, I’m a big tech enthusiast who enjoys exploring peripherals, gaming setups, and sharing that passion online.
